title: ReferClaw: Disambiguating User Intent for Egocentric Assistance
title_zh: ReferClaw：为自我中心辅助消解用户意图的歧义

paragraphs.en: ReferClaw通过先提出澄清性问题消解用户意图，提升自我中心流式问答的准确率并具零样本迁移能力。 Users of egocentric AI assistants often ask short, ambiguous questions whose intended referents cannot be uniquely resolved from video and dialogue history. For example, "Where did I leave it?" may refer to several previously handled objects. Existing VideoQA systems typically commit to a single interpretation, risking plausible but intention-misaligned answers. We introduce ReferClaw, an agentic framework that formulates egocentric streaming QA as an interactive process: the assistant asks clarifying questions to resolve user intent before answering. Three cooperating agents identify candidate interpretations, request clarification, and generate answers grounded in the resolved intent and visual evidence. A bounded, cost-aware policy balances expected information gain against user effort while limiting clarification turns and question complexity. Referclaw learns from interaction through intent-specific skill updates and process-reward-guided policy optimization with agent-level credit assignment. Evaluations on augmented egocentric QA benchmarks demonstrate improved answer accuracy and joint answer-and-grounding performance over existing baselines, alongside zero-shot transfer across datasets. These findings support interactive clarification as a practical approach to resolving online user intent in egocentric streaming assistance.
paragraphs.zh: ReferClaw 通过先提出澄清性问题来消解用户意图，提升了自我中心流式问答的准确率，并具备零样本迁移能力。自我中心 AI 助手的用户常常提出简短、含糊的问题，其指代对象无法仅凭视频和对话历史唯一确定。 例如，“我把它放哪儿了？”可能指代此前处理过的多个物体中的任何一个。 现有的 VideoQA 系统通常会直接采用单一解释，从而可能给出看似合理却与用户意图不符的答案。 我们提出 ReferClaw，这是一个智能体框架，将自我中心流式问答构建为一个交互过程：助手在回答之前先提出澄清性问题以消解用户意图。 三个相互协作的智能体分别负责识别候选解释、请求澄清，以及基于已消解的意图和视觉证据生成答案。 一种有界且成本感知的策略在期望信息增益与用户付出之间取得平衡，同时限制澄清轮次和问题复杂度。 ReferClaw 通过意图特定的技能更新以及带智能体级信用分配的过程奖励引导的策略优化，从交互中学习。 在增强的自我中心问答基准上的评估表明，与现有基线相比，ReferClaw 提升了答案准确率以及答案与定位的联合性能，并实现了跨数据集的零样本迁移。 这些发现支持将交互式澄清作为在自我中心流式辅助中消解在线用户意图的一种实用方法。
